title: 2 Americans sentenced to life in prison for murder of Quebec couple in Dominica
summary: The two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica in December 2023 were sentenced on Monday to life in prison without parole.

image.caption: Jonathan Lehrer leaves court after being denied bail on charges related to the killings of Canadian businessman Daniel Langlois and his partner, Dominique Marchand, in Roseau, Dominica, on April 18, 2024. (Clyde Jno Baptiste/AP Photo)

blocks.text: The two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica in December 2023 were sentenced on Monday to life in prison without parole.
Bodies of Daniel Langlois and Dominique Marchand were found in a burned-out vehicle near eco-resort in 2023
The two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica have been sentenced to life in prison without parole.
Jonathan Lehrer and Robert Thomas Snyder Jr. were found guilty in July of killing the couple in December 2023.
The victims' bodies were discovered in a burned-out vehicle near a luxury eco-resort they owned on the island.
Prosecutor Keith Scotland says the Americans have appealed the verdict and can also appeal the sentence.

items: 2 men found guilty of murdering Daniel Langlois and Dominique Marchand in Dominica

blocks.text: Court documents show Langlois had been involved in a years-long dispute with Lehrer over access to a road leading to the resort.
Langlois founded Montreal-based SoftImage, whose 3D animation technology was used in Hollywood blockbusters including Jurassic Park.

In a statement shared last week by family spokesperson Sylvie Deslauriers, Langlois's mother said her son's ashes were recently returned to Canada, allowing her to finally bury him nearly three years after the killings.
